diagnostic_proposal.numerical_scope: Record all four ranks x48 actual GDN native core calls, source identities, actual CPU request/query starts/slot identity, original mixed_qkv/a/b inputs, gate values, selected native FP32 state and BF16 output. diagnostic_proposal.bounded_raw: At most33 model turns/arm. Initial and after-state frames only once, with before-state hash checked against the preceding after frame for the same retained slot.
